subject: english
question: According to legend, what did Roma do to stop the Trojan men at the banks of the Tiber?

options.text: She destroyed the city of Troy.
She declared herself as the ruler.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****She burnt the trojan ships**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given passage, it has been stated in the **second paragraph** - *'... Roma and the other women objected ... She led the women in the burning of the Trojan ships and so effectively stranded the Trojan survivors ... '. *
 
• This shows that Roma burnt the Trojan ships to stop the Trojan men at the banks of the Tiber.
 
• Thus, **option 1 **is the correct answer.
